items.content_html: A Centralised National Portal with a lightweight update model is vital for Nigeria. The "No Bed Conundrum" causes avoidable emergency deaths daily, as ambulances navigate blindly between tertiary centers like LUTH, LASUTH, or regional General Hospitals without real-time status. Real-time visibility across wards saves lives nationwide.
